groups.transcript:
W: Hello, Mark. I was reviewing our customer satisfaction ratings for the third quarter, and while our delivery speed received glowing reviews, our online returns process scored below average.
M: I noticed that as well, Hannah. Several customers left comments stating that printing physical return labels and finding drop-off lockers was cumbersome.
W: Perhaps we should partner with a courier that provides QR-code drop-offs where customers don't need to print labels at home.
M: That's a fantastic idea. I will contact Swift Logistics this afternoon to check their integration pricing.
groups._speech: Questions 32 through 34 refer to the following conversation. Hello, Mark. I was reviewing our customer satisfaction ratings for the third quarter, and while our delivery speed received glowing reviews, our online returns process scored below average. I noticed that as well, Hannah. Several customers left comments stating that printing physical return labels and finding drop-off lockers was cumbersome. Perhaps we should partner with a courier that provides QR-code drop-offs where customers don't need to print labels at home. That's a fantastic idea. I will contact Swift Logistics this afternoon to check their integration pricing.

questions.content: What aspect of the company's service received low ratings?
questions.explanation: Người phụ nữ nhận xét: "...our online returns process scored below average" → Chọn (A).

questions.content: What problem did customers mention in their reviews?
options: Customer service phone lines were busy
The return window of 14 days was too short
questions.explanation: Người nam cho biết khách hàng phản ánh việc in nhãn đổi trả và tìm tủ nhận hàng phiền phức ("printing physical return labels ... was cumbersome") → Chọn (A).

questions.content: What will Mark do this afternoon?
options: Contact a logistics courier about QR-code drop-offs
Redesign the company's mobile shopping application
questions.explanation: Mark nói: "I will contact Swift Logistics this afternoon to check their integration pricing" → Chọn (A).

questions.content: Participants found the interactive workshop on digital marketing analytics extremely -------.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc "find + O + adj" (nhận thấy cái gì như thế nào) → sau phó từ chỉ mức độ "extremely" cần tính từ "informative" (bổ ích, hữu ích).

questions.content: Hotel guests dining at the seaside restaurant are entitled to a complimentary breakfast ------- every morning.
questions.explanation: Cụm danh từ cố định trong ngành khách sạn "breakfast buffet" (bữa ăn sáng tự chọn).

questions.content: Delegates attending the summit are requested to register ------- on the official event portal.
questions.explanation: Hành động đăng ký tác động lên chính chủ ngữ "Delegates" → dùng đại từ phản thân "themselves" (tự đăng ký).

questions.content: The technical seminar was rescheduled ------- the keynote speaker missed his connecting flight.
questions.explanation: Theo sau là một mệnh đề hoàn chỉnh có chủ ngữ và động từ ("the keynote speaker missed his connecting flight") chỉ nguyên nhân → chọn liên từ "because".

questions.content: Customer parking spaces are situated directly ------- the primary supermarket entrance.
questions.explanation: Vị trí không gian của bãi đỗ xe so với cổng vào siêu thị → chọn giới từ nơi chốn "behind" (phía sau).

groups.passage:
NOTICE TO ALL SYSTEM USERS
From: IT Infrastructure & Operations
Date: September 5
Subject: Scheduled CRM System Maintenance

Please be advised that our central Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform will undergo routine system maintenance this Saturday, September 9, beginning at 11:00 P.M. and concluding at 4:00 A.M. on Sunday morning.

During this five-hour maintenance window, the database will be temporarily [131] ------- to all personnel. This maintenance is essential to deploy critical security patches and enhance server performance. [132] -------. We advise all sales and support representatives to finalize and save all active transaction records before logging off on Friday afternoon.

If you require urgent client contact records during the maintenance outage, please export the necessary files [133] ------- Saturday noon. Regular database operations will resume [134] ------- at 4:30 A.M. on Sunday.

questions.content: Choose the best word to fill in blank [131].
questions.explanation: Trong thời gian hệ thống bảo trì máy chủ, cơ sở dữ liệu sẽ tạm thời "không thể truy cập được" → chọn tính từ phủ định "inaccessible".

questions.content: Choose the best sentence to fill in blank [132].
options: These enhancements will ensure faster query times and improved data safety.
The marketing campaign proposal was rejected by our overseas partner.
All international travel receipts must be turned in by Thursday.
The executive dining lounge will be closed during the holidays.
questions.explanation: Câu trước nói về mục đích nâng cấp bảo mật và hiệu năng. Câu (A) tiếp nối mạch logic: "Những nâng cấp này sẽ đảm bảo thời gian truy vấn nhanh hơn và dữ liệu an toàn hơn".

questions.content: Choose the best preposition to fill in blank [133].
questions.explanation: Chỉ mốc thời gian phải hoàn tất trước khi sự kiện xảy ra: "before Saturday noon" (trước trưa Thứ Bảy).

questions.content: Choose the best adverb to fill in blank [134].
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ "will resume" tại mốc thời gian cụ thể cần phó từ (adverb) → chọn "promptly" (đúng giờ, kịp thời).

groups.passage:
APEX AUTOMOTIVE REPAIR
Customer Feedback & Service Evaluation
Date of Service: August 18
Customer: David Miller
Vehicle: 2021 Silverton Sedan

Service Evaluation:
• Punctuality: Excellent (5/5)
• Work Quality: Excellent (5/5)
• Facility Comfort: Average (3/5)
• Pricing Transparency: Excellent (5/5)

Customer Remarks:
"I brought my sedan in for the scheduled 30,000-mile inspection and front brake pad replacement. Technician Carlos did a wonderful job walking me through the rotor measurements and finished the job thirty minutes ahead of schedule. My only minor suggestion pertains to the customer lounge: seating was limited, and the guest Wi-Fi was quite spotty. Aside from that, the mechanical work was top-notch, and I will certainly return for future oil changes."

Manager Response:
Date: August 20
From: Brenda Larson, Service Manager

Dear Mr. Miller,
Thank you for sharing your experience. We are delighted that Carlos provided prompt, transparent service for your brake inspection. Regarding our waiting area, we are scheduled to expand the customer lounge next month with extra workstations and high-speed fiber internet. To show our appreciation for your loyalty, please present coupon code APEX-15OFF during your next visit to receive 15% off any standard maintenance service.

questions.content: Why did Mr. Miller bring his vehicle to Apex Automotive?
options: For a scheduled inspection and brake pad replacement
To repair severe collision body damage
To test-drive a newly arrived Silverton sedan
questions.explanation: Khách hàng viết: "I brought my sedan in for the scheduled 30,000-mile inspection and front brake pad replacement" → Chọn (A).

questions.content: What will Apex Automotive do next month?
options: Expand the waiting lounge and install faster internet
Relocate the auto repair shop to a new facility
Discontinue the promotional discount coupon program
questions.explanation: Người quản lý phản hồi: "...we are scheduled to expand the customer lounge next month with extra workstations and high-speed fiber internet" → Chọn (A).

groups.passage:
ANNOUNCEMENT
GREENVALE BOTANICAL GARDENS
Annual Plant Sale & Horticultural Exhibition
Dates: May 20–22 | Hours: 9:00 A.M. – 6:00 P.M. Daily

Greenvale Botanical Gardens is thrilled to host our 15th Annual Plant Sale! Browse thousands of rare perennial flowers, indigenous shrubs, and organic vegetable seedlings cultivated by our master gardeners.

Event Highlights:
• Free 30-minute gardening workshops held daily at 11:00 A.M. and 2:00 P.M. in the glass conservatory.
• Members-Only Early Access: Garden members enjoy exclusive admission on Friday, May 20 from 8:00 A.M. to 10:00 A.M., plus an extra 15% discount on all plant purchases.
• Soil testing station: Bring a cup of backyard soil for immediate mineral analysis ($5 per sample; free for members).

Admission is $12 for adults, $6 for students, and free for children under six and current garden members. Parking is free in the North Lot.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

REVIEW POSTING
User: Sarah Jenkins | Date: May 23
Rating: ★★★★★

"I attended the Greenvale Plant Sale on Saturday morning with my family. The variety of heirloom tomato seedlings was astonishing, and the staff at the soil testing booth gave us practical tips on improving our garden soil. Even though the North Lot was full by 10:30 A.M., parking attendants directed us smoothly to the overflow lot at the adjacent middle school. We also attended the 2:00 P.M. indoor gardening talk, which was incredibly insightful. We definitely plan to purchase a family membership before next year's sale!"

questions.content: What benefit do garden members receive on Friday, May 20?
options: Exclusive early admission and a 15% plant discount
Free admission for up to ten non-member guests
A complimentary pair of professional gardening shears
Reserved parking stalls in the overflow lot
questions.explanation: Thông báo nêu: "Garden members enjoy exclusive admission on Friday, May 20 from 8:00 A.M. to 10:00 A.M., plus an extra 15% discount on all plant purchases" → Chọn (A).

questions.content: Where did Sarah Jenkins park her car during her visit?
options: At an overflow parking lot at a nearby school
In the garden's primary North Lot
On an adjacent residential neighborhood street
questions.explanation: Sarah viết: "...the North Lot was full by 10:30 A.M., parking attendants directed us smoothly to the overflow lot at the adjacent middle school" → Chọn (A).

questions.content: What does Sarah Jenkins indicate she will do before next year?
options: Donate plant seeds to the conservatory
Host a gardening workshop in her backyard
questions.explanation: Câu cuối bài review: "We definitely plan to purchase a family membership before next year's sale!" → Chọn (A).
